easyPrerequisites: You control up to four lands excluding Minamo that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate up to four lands except Minamo by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Minamo and up to four other lands.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.
